brand.name: Twinkle Clean
brand.voice: Professional, warm and practical — a hands-on cleaning company that speaks plainly, backs claims with real experience, and reassures without overselling.
brand.audience: Melbourne small and large business owners needing reliable commercial/office cleaning for offices, retail stores and restaurants; homeowners and renters needing carpet steam/deep cleaning; and tenants/landlords needing end-of-tenancy cleaning to secure their bond.
usps: 100% satisfaction guarantee backed by a quality control system
All cleaners are well trained and hold up-to-date police checks
Available seven days a week including weekends and public holidays at no extra charge
Budget-friendly, competitive pricing for workplaces big and small
Friendly cleaners with strong English-speaking communication skills
brand.operating_hours: 24/7 (contactable); cleaning team operates seven days a week including evenings, weekends and public holidays at no extra charge

business_goals: Grow commercial/office cleaning and carpet steam cleaning across the Melbourne CBD, South East Melbourne and East Melbourne, targeting commercially active suburbs (e.g. Dandenong). Pakenham is out of the target range.
compliance_restrictions: Complies with in-house OHS standards and staff handbook covering manual handling, safe chemical handling and basic first aid. All cleaners hold current police checks. No specific industry certifications or licence numbers.
customer_process: Initial enquiry by phone (0498 182 989), email (admin@twinkleclean.com.au) or website quote request, stating the service required and preferred contact method
Discuss requirements, priorities, service frequency, property size, access arrangements and any specific concerns; arrange an onsite inspection for larger or ongoing commercial work
Provide a competitive, customised quote covering the recommended cleaning scope, schedule, frequency, pricing and any optional specialist services
On acceptance, confirm the start date, access details and site requirements, then allocate suitable, experienced cleaners
Brief cleaners with clear instructions, checklists and site-specific training; team arrives on time with professional equipment and completes the service to the agreed standard
After the service, respond to feedback or additional requests (email replies typically within one hour during business hours) and run ongoing quality checks for regular clients
success_stories: For a long-term client operating an obstetrics clinic, our team discovered during an evening clean that a kitchen water pipe had burst and water was spreading through the premises. We immediately contacted the client and arranged emergency flood restoration overnight, containing the damage, protecting the clinic and preventing water reaching the tenant downstairs — a situation that could otherwise have caused significant property damage and business disruption.
certifications: Up-to-date police checks for all cleaners
OHS training: manual handling, safe chemical handling and basic first aid
subject_matter_experts: Carpet and tile cleaning specialist (carpet steam cleaning, stain treatment, commercial carpet maintenance, tile and grout cleaning, high-pressure extraction)
insurance: Public liability insurance ($20M) plus WorkCover cover for staff.
guarantees: 100% Satisfaction Guarantee — corrective cleaning arranged where an agreed-scope area falls short
Bond-back cleaning guarantee for end-of-tenancy work, subject to agreed scope and inspection conditions
why_started: Founded by a former cleaner whose services were in high demand and valued by customers. The business grew from a passion for cleaning and a recognition of strong demand for a professional, reliable, customer-focused cleaning service in Melbourne — an opportunity to build a full-service company delivering on quality, professionalism and customer satisfaction where other providers fell short.
